name: FEG Plus Hair Growth Spray 50ml | Anti-Hair Loss & Regrowth Solution
description:
FEG Plus Hair Growth Spray is a clinically tested solution designed to fight hair fall, thinning, and slow growth. Enriched with biotin, ginseng extract, keratin, and argan oil, this advanced formula nourishes the scalp, strengthens roots, and boosts natural hair regrowth.
Key Features
 Stimulates hair follicles for fast regrowth
 Reduces hair fall, thinning, and breakage
 Nourishes scalp and improves blood circulation
 Strengthens roots and repairs damaged strands
 Non-greasy, safe, and easy-to-use spray
 Suitable for both men and women
How to Use
 Shake well before use
 Spray directly on clean, dry scalp (especially thinning areas)
 Massage gently and let it absorb
 Use twice daily for visible results within weeks
Material/Composition
Biotin, ginseng extract, keratin, argan oil
Safety Information
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Discontinue if irritation occurs
Package Includes
 1 × FEG Hair Growth & Anti-Hair Loss Serum (50ml)
